children.text: To begin, click Next. If you are unable to finish in one sitting, feel free to save your work and revisit later through your onboarding link. You will generate a temporary link through the link in your original onboarding email. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to your Tekion Professional Services Manager.

Pre go-live training is conducted in dedicated training areas. There will be 1 training area for accounting + sales / F&I and 1 separate training area for parts + service. Conference rooms, break rooms and any space that are away from distractions are preferred. The only requirements are that there is internet connectivity and between 3-4 dedicated training PCs (each with a keyboard and a mouse). Configuring additional, applicable hardware for users to be trained on is also recommended (common examples below):
Label printers for deal jackets, parts special order labels and vehicle labels
Mobile devices for mobile repair order creation, parts scanning and vehicle barcode scanning
iPads for F&I Menu and forms casting
MICR printer for printing test checks

During our hardware/technology discussions and Strategy and Process meetings, we will partner with you to finalize these areas so that they will be ready for training in the weeks preceding Go Live. Your Tekion Implementation Manager will partner with you to finalize the arrangements and confirm the training schedule. Please provide the areas of the dealership that you have in mind for these training rooms below.
